entries.root_cause: Persistence invocation equivalence covered direct and optional method calls plus ordinary call/apply helpers, but omitted optional invocation of the call/apply helper itself, allowing the same forbidden write through call?.(...) or apply?.(...).
Defense layers did not compose fail-closed when secret taint existed only after static computed-key alias propagation and the governed sink was invoked through call?.(...) or apply?.(...).

Computed sink normalization handled bracket access and optional invocation independently but did not normalize JavaScript optional computed access receiver?.[member], so alias-tainted arguments could reach the governed sink without classification.

SQL-bearing execution extraction recognized bare execution method names but not statically computed or balanced-grouped execution callees, so authority-changing tagged SQL could evade classification by changing only the database method access syntax.
horizontal_audit: bare query execute exec run and sql calls

entries.root_cause: The canonical secret-flow fallback scanned raw decoded artifact text, so comments and ordinary string literals could be mistaken for executable secret provenance or sink calls, creating false-positive denials on bounded G2 code.

The canonical SQL fallback treated any grant/revoke-shaped prose inside methods named query/run/etc. as database authority instead of requiring an authority-shaped SQL statement within the actual execution surface, reintroducing bounded display-text false positives.

Secret taint propagation covered scalar aliases and object destructuring but omitted array destructuring, so raw credential values could be rebound through declaration-time or later array patterns and reach governed sinks unclassified.

SQL execution analysis resolved only SQL-named bindings, allowing an arbitrary static binding passed to query/execute/exec/run/sql to hide authority-changing SQL even though the execution callee made the value an executable SQL surface.
horizontal_audit: query execute exec run sql calls

entries.root_cause: Structural DDL matching scanned display literals as executable SQL, creating false-positive denials for UI/help text containing CREATE or DROP phrases instead of limiting DDL analysis to SQL-bearing bindings and governed execution surfaces.
horizontal_audit: arbitrary bindings passed to SQL execution
